howto.what: Claude 能教你如何在 plant-store CLI 中添加自定义指令，包括注册命令、使用 SDK 客户端、处理认证等。
howto.when: 当你询问如何为 plant-store CLI 编写自定义命令或提及“plant-store”“自定义命令”等关键词时。

say.text: 帮我在 plant-store 里加一个获取植物的命令。
如何在 plant-store 自定义命令中使用 SDK 客户端？

howto.what_en: Claude can teach you how to add custom commands to the plant-store CLI, including registering commands, using the SDK client, and handling authentication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about creating custom commands for plant-store CLI or mention keywords like "plant-store" or "custom commands".

say_en.text: Help me add a command to get a plant in plant-store.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to edit custom.rs and register a get command.

say_en.text: How to use the SDK client in plant-store custom commands?
say_en.note: Claude will show the super::sdk::client(ctx) pattern.
